# Exterior

What Tillstack relates to, by how each relates to it.

## Who it serves

### Independent shops

They sell online and in person, so a sale lost at their till is the one thing that counts. Their settled sales per day, as one total, show it ([the daily sales](https://tillstack.example/sales), read 2026-11-20).

## What it depends on

### Stripe

Payments run on it, so its fees and its outages are ours ([its status page](https://status.stripe.com/), read 2026-11-20).

## Its alternative

### Cartwell

The checkout shops leave for, or come from ([its public pricing page](https://cartwell.example/pricing), read 2026-11-20).
